Two {creature:Hero|Heroes} guard a precious treasure deep in the {wiki:Hero Cave}, north of Edron. Go down the cave, pass the dragons and clear the room of the two Heroes to open the two chests: a {item:Club Ring} and a {item:Red Gem}.
Two heroes guard a precious treasure in the depths of the Hero Cave.
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
As you approach the final room, go slowly and pull the monsters one by one: there are two {creature:Hero|Heroes} together.
1. Going down through the Hero Cave

If you are not in Edron, take a boat: talk to the captain at your city's port (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the **Edron** port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

From the port, head **north** to the Edron cave (the {wiki:Hero Cave}), north of the city, at the spot in the image ({coord:33164,31638,7}). Outside there are {creature:Hunter|Hunters} and {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}.
Down there, kill the {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors} and go to the next hole.

Kill the {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, a {creature:Priestess} and the {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}. Follow the path in the image and go down the stairs.
Follow the path in the image, killing {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}. Go down the stairs.
Killing the dragons and entering the hole
Kill the **3 {creature:Dragon|Dragons}** and enter the hole in the image.
The dragon room and the hole
Dragons spit fire in an area: don't stand in front of several at the same time.
Here you face 1 {creature:Hero} and 2 or 3 {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}. Keep going down.
The floor with the first Hero
Here you will find 2 to 3 {creature:Priestess|Priestesses} and 2 {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}.
The path south to the Heroes' room
2. The room of the two Heroes

Head **south**. When you are near the room, advance slowly. Inside there are **2 {creature:Hero|Heroes}**, **1 {creature:Priestess}**, **2 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}** and **1 {creature:Orc Shaman}**. Kill them.
The two Heroes together hit hard: try to separate them.
In the **south** of the room there are 2 chests. Open both.

To leave, go back the **same way**: retrace the images in reverse, use the {item:Rope} on the holes you went down (the one in the dragon room and those on the first floors) and go up the stairs you came down, to the Hero Cave entrance. Outside, head **south** to the city of **Edron**; to leave the island talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the port ({key:hi}, the name of the city, for example {key:thais}, and {key:yes}).
